result.summary: Found 2 visually broken areas: one image appears stuck in a loading state, and the bottom navigation is overlapping the content below.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows a loading spinner over the image area, suggesting the restaurant image is still loading or failed to render properly.
issues.suggestion: Verify the image request and loading state; if the image is unavailable, replace the spinner with a fallback thumbnail or error placeholder after a timeout.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar overlaps the feed content, cutting off the next restaurant card at the bottom of the screen.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding/inset to the scrollable feed so content remains fully visible above the fixed navigation bar.
